newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says 110-120 yen best dollar/yen rate.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says 110-120 yen best dollar/yen rate.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Wednesday that a dollar/yen rate of 110-120 yen was best for the company.

Asked what the firm's view was of current foreign exchange rates, Toyota vice chairman Iwao Isomura told news conference: "Steep fluctuations are the worst thing. We want the exchange rate to remain between 110 and 120 yen. We think 110-120 is the best rate."
Toyota had assumed an average yen/dollar exchange rate of 112 yen in drawing up its 1997/98 business plan, unchanged from the previous year, he said.
A one yen gain in the dollar against the yen translates into an extra 15 billion yen annually for Toyota in operating profits, he said.
